Six Die in Helicopter Crash Near Joshimath

A privately operated helicopter carrying six people crashed near Joshimath, Uttarakhand, shortly after taking off from Badrinath. All six individuals on board died in the incident. The crash has renewed concerns regarding the safety of civilian helicopter operations in the Himalayan region, highlighting recurring fatal accidents and operational risks.
